edges.mechanism: MK-4 is a functional vitamin K that restores carboxylation of clotting factors and antagonises warfarin; vitamin K2 is used in Japan to reverse warfarin coagulopathy. Prior warfarin use excluded from MK-4 trials.
edges.evidence: Case report of K2 reversal; MK-7 dose-response in VKA-treated volunteers (10-45 ug lowered INR); ODS advises consistent vitamin K intake; no MK-4-specific dose-response study

edges.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic antagonism of VKA anticoagulation; INR fall and loss of anticoagulant control.
edges.evidence: Volunteer acenocoumarol study with MK-7; extrapolated to MK-4

edges.mechanism: Long-term warfarin use associated with 68-79% lower brain MK-4 concentrations; clinical significance unknown.
edges.evidence: Autopsy cohort (n=381); observational

edges.mechanism: Proposed complementary action (carboxylation of osteocalcin plus antiresorptive); combination tested in JOINT-03.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=105) found no additive BMD or turnover effect of MK-4 45 mg/d; low certainty

edges.mechanism: MK-4 prevented prednisolone-induced lumbar BMD loss, comparable to alfacalcidol.
edges.evidence: Small RCT (n=60, 8 weeks); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: MK-4 synthesis from menadione uses mevalonate-pathway intermediates; atorvastatin lowered renal MK-4 formation ~45% in mice; statin plus PPI associated with highest PIVKA-II in dialysis patients.
edges.evidence: Animal study and post hoc dialysis cohort; clinical relevance unknown

edges.mechanism: Menatetrenone 45 mg/d added to sorafenib increased objective response (27.3% vs 4.5%) and PFS (HR 0.44) in HCC.
edges.evidence: Open-label phase II RCT (n=44); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Combination with MK-4 suppressed VEGF and reduced cumulative HCC recurrence; neither agent alone did.
edges.evidence: Small clinical study (n=87); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fat malabsorption reduces absorption of fat-soluble vitamin K; MK-4 absorption is fat-dependent.
edges.evidence: Pilot study (non-significant vitamin K fall); PK study of dietary fat

edges.mechanism: High-dose alpha-tocopherol antagonises vitamin K (raised PIVKA-II) and lowered extrahepatic MK-4 in rats; shared omega-hydroxylation/PXR pathways.
edges.evidence: Two 12-week RCTs of 1000 IU/d (PIVKA-II rise); rat feeding study; mechanistic review

edges.mechanism: Vitamin D drives calcium absorption while vitamin K carboxylates osteocalcin/MGP; alfacalcidol plus menatetrenone raised lumbar BMD more than either alone; MK-4 attenuated alfacalcidol-induced serum calcium rise.
edges.evidence: Small Japanese RCTs positive; null RCT in North American women on calcium + D3; review; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Phylloquinone is converted to MK-4 via menadione and UBIAD1; additive vitamin K load relevant for VKA users. K1 1 mg and MK-4 45 mg had similar ucOC effects.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic (human enzyme, rat tracer) and RCT data

edges.mechanism: MK-7 has far higher bioavailability and longer half-life at nutritional doses than MK-4; combined use adds vitamin K activity relevant to VKA therapy.
edges.evidence: Human PK comparison; volunteer anticoagulation studies

edges.mechanism: Calcium was co-administered in most menatetrenone fracture trials; the OF study compared calcium alone vs calcium plus menatetrenone.
edges.evidence: Large open-label RCT null on primary endpoint; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Uremic lipoprotein transport and renal MK-4 synthesis are disturbed; functional vitamin K deficiency common.
edges.evidence: Translational study with dialysis patients

edges.mechanism: MK-4 45-90 mg/d studied for HCC chemoprevention; small trials and MAs positive, phase III RCT null; also preserves BMD in cirrhosis.
edges.evidence: Phase III RCT (n=548) null; MAs of small trials; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Menatetrenone absorption tripled with higher meal fat; malabsorption expected to reduce exposure.
edges.evidence: Human PK crossover study

edges.mechanism: Vitamin K (MK-4) lowers DCP in HCC patients with deficiency-like kinetics, with rebound after 7-10 days, potentially masking this HCC tumour marker.
edges.evidence: Clinical pharmacodynamic study

edges.mechanism: MK-4 rapidly lowers ucOC and ucOC/OC (up to ~82%) and raises total OC; markers reflect recent intake.
edges.evidence: RCTs and MAs

edges.mechanism: In VKA-treated patients vitamin K intake lowers INR (true pharmacodynamic effect).
edges.evidence: Volunteer acenocoumarol study

edges.mechanism: VKORC1 risk alleles modestly associated with osteopenia/osteoporosis; effect on MK-4 response untested.
edges.evidence: MA of 6 studies (n=7335); OR 1.16
